notes: Tasks are computer-use instructions for UI-TARS Desktop (or any GUI agent).
Evidence convention: <taskId>-<NN>-<slug>.png inside the run folder.

tasks.title: VSIX installed and activated
tasks.instruction: In VS Code (workspace C:\devsrc\ibis-assistant), open the Output panel (Ctrl+Shift+U), select the channel 'Ibis Assistant' from the dropdown, and read the most recent activation line.
expected: Output channel named 'Ibis Assistant' exists
activation line reads 'activated (ide-host: vendor, engine: 1.144.x)' (vendor in packaged install, package in dev)
no error entries about failing to load the runtime host

tasks.title: Status bar item
tasks.instruction: Look at the bottom-right status bar of VS Code. Find the item whose label contains 'Ibis'. Note its icon and text (spawn or attach), then click it and observe the notification/output that opens.
expected: status bar shows 'Ibis spawn' or 'Ibis attach' with a terminal or cloud icon
optional glyphs: lightning (LM bridge listening), check (MCP provider registered)
clicking runs Ibis Assistant: Status (toast and/or output channel per ibis.status.outputMode)

tasks.title: Memory tree view
tasks.instruction: Open the activity bar, click the Ibis Assistant icon, and in the 'Memory' view expand the 'decision' kind. Then run the search (magnifier icon in the view title) with query 'settings' and read one entry by clicking it.
expected: view shows 8 kinds: decision, fix, rule, constraint, gotcha, design, fact, ask
expanding a kind lists entries from MCP memory_search (requires Ollama/embedding provider up)
clicking an entry opens a read-only 'ibis-memory:' document with metadata header and content
search adds a 'search: "..."' root node with matches; refresh icon reloads expanded nodes

tasks.title: Remember Selection with provenance
tasks.instruction: Select 3-5 lines of code in any file of the workspace, right-click the selection, choose 'Ibis Assistant: Remember Selection', pick kind 'fact' in the quick pick, type title 'UI smoke provenance check', and confirm. Read the final toast.
expected: quick pick shows the 7 kinds (decision, fix, rule, constraint, gotcha, design, fact)
final toast contains 'Ibis Remembered (fact, team)' and the file:start-end range
the stored memory content ends with 'Source: <relative-path>:<start>-<end>' (verify via tree view detail)

tasks.title: Remember File from editor and explorer
tasks.instruction: Right-click a file in the VS Code Explorer, choose 'Ibis Assistant: Remember File', pick kind 'fact', type title 'UI smoke file check', and type content 'This file exists at UI smoke time'. Repeat once from an open editor without selection using the Command Palette.
expected: both entry points complete with a toast 'Ibis Remembered (fact, team) for <relative-path>'
memory content ends with 'Source: <relative-path>:1-<N> (whole file)'

tasks.title: Chat instruction session contract
tasks.instruction: In Copilot Chat (agent mode), type '/', find 'ibis-session-contract' in the instructions picker, attach it, then ask the agent to start working on a small task and watch whether it calls load_session_context exactly once at the start.
expected: instruction 'ibis-session-contract' is attachable from the '/' picker
the agent calls load_session_context once per session and avoids memory_* spam
the contract does NOT appear as a slash skill (no duplicates across VSIX/plugin)

tasks.title: Onboarding walkthrough
tasks.instruction: Open Help > Welcome, go to the 'Get Started with Ibis Assistant' walkthrough, and click through all 4 steps. Click the command links in step 1 and step 4.
expected: 4 steps present: install-binary, choose-backend, browse-memory, remember-with-provenance
command links open extension settings / the Ibis Assistant view / Remember commands
steps get checked by their completion events (onView, onSettingChanged, onCommand)

tasks.title: MCP provider confirmations
tasks.instruction: In Copilot Chat agent mode send: 'Use the Ibis MCP server to call load_session_context and get_working_state for this workspace.' Then send: 'Use memory_add to store a fact titled "R3 smoke" with content "R3 ui smoke entry".' Watch for confirmation dialogs.
expected: read-only tools (load_session_context, get_working_state) execute with ZERO confirmation dialogs
memory_add (readOnlyHint: false) shows a confirmation dialog before executing

tasks.title: Plugin skills as slash commands
tasks.instruction: In Copilot Chat, type '/ibis' in the prompt box and list every completion shown. Then run '/ibis status' and read the reply.
expected: 5 skills appear: /ibis usage, /ibis readiness, /ibis status, /ibis remember, /ibis set-working-state
/ibis status returns backend/AI/ticketing status via settings_get

tasks.title: Plugin MCP server started
tasks.instruction: Open Command Palette, run 'MCP: List Servers', and check the entry named 'ibis' contributed by the plugin (spawn child). Read its state.
expected: an 'ibis' MCP server is listed and startable (spawn: ibis -mode stdio -runtime-mode plugin)
tools become available in agent mode after start

tasks.title: sessionStart hook injects contract
tasks.instruction: Start a NEW agent session in chat. Ask: 'What instructions were injected at session start about Ibis?' and check the GitHub Copilot Chat Hooks output log for a sessionStart command hook run of session-start.mjs.
expected: the agent received the Ibis session contract (load_session_context once; memory hygiene)
the hook log shows the sessionStart hook for the ibis plugin executed successfully

tasks.title: agentStop hook conditional reminder
tasks.instruction: Ask the agent to make a small code edit (e.g. add a comment line to a scratch file) and end the turn WITHOUT capturing any memory. Observe whether the turn is extended once with a reminder about capture_observation/memory_add. Then let the agent capture a memory and end the turn again.
expected: first stop: exactly ONE forced continuation with the Ibis end-of-turn reminder
second stop (after a capture): turn ends normally, no reminder loop
no runaway loops (max one forced continuation per turn)

tasks.title: Forensics agent output format
tasks.instruction: In chat, select the '@ibis-forensics' agent and ask: 'Why does scripts/sync-ide-host.mjs exist in this repo?' Wait for the final answer.
expected: answer contains Finding / Evidence / Confidence sections
only read-only Ibis tools were used (why_changed, memory_search, ask_project...); no file edits

tasks.title: Automations declared
tasks.instruction: Open the plugin view where automations are listed (Customizations / Plugins > ibis > automations) and verify the two scheduled automations exist.
expected: nightly-ingest (cron 0 3 * * *) and weekly-consolidate (cron ven 10:30) are declared
no run expected during the gate; only declaration is verified
